q: How do I book a plumber?
a: Go to the Home page, select 'Plumber' from the service categories, click 'Find Near Me', and choose from the available technicians in your area. You can then confirm the booking with one click.

q: What services are available?
a: We offer Plumbing, Electrical repairs, AC repair and maintenance, Carpentry, Painting, Appliance repair, Masonry, and Cleaning services — all bookable on-demand.

q: How long does it take for a technician to arrive?
a: ETA depends on distance. Our system estimates travel at an average urban speed of 30 km/h. Most technicians arrive within 15–45 minutes for requests within 10 km.

q: Is there a call-out charge?
a: There is a base visit charge of ₹150. All additional charges depend on the work done and are agreed upon between you and the technician before work begins.

q: How do I know the technician is qualified?
a: Every technician on our platform is verified, background-checked, and rated by previous customers. You can view their rating, reviews, and skills on their profile before booking.

q: Can I cancel a booking?
a: Yes. You can cancel a booking anytime before the technician has arrived. Once the job is in progress ('Arrived' status), cancellation may incur a small fee.

q: How does real-time tracking work?
a: Once a technician accepts your booking, you'll see their live location on a map in the Tracking page. The marker updates in real-time as they travel to you.

q: Is my payment information safe?
a: Currently, payments are made directly to the technician in cash. We are working on integrating secure online payment options in a future update.

q: What if the technician doesn't show up?
a: If a technician fails to arrive without notification, please report it through the app. We will rebook you with another technician immediately at no extra charge.

q: How are technician ratings calculated?
a: Ratings are the average of all customer reviews submitted after job completion. Technicians are removed from the platform if their rating falls below 3.5.

q: Can I request a specific technician again?
a: Yes! Search by skill, and if your preferred technician is available, you can select them from the results list and book them directly.

q: What is the maximum service distance?
a: We currently serve bookings within 50 km of your location. If no technician is available within that range, we'll notify you and suggest alternatives.

q: How do I become a technician on the platform?
a: Register with 'Technician' role, select your skills, and add your location. Our team verifies your profile within 24 hours and then you'll start receiving job requests.

q: What are the safety guidelines for AC repair?
a: Always turn off the main power before any electrical work. For AC gas refilling, only certified technicians (EPA 608 or equivalent) should handle refrigerants. Ensure proper ventilation.

q: How do I prepare for a plumber visit?
a: Clear access to the problem area, turn off the water supply under the affected fixture if you know how, and note the issue details (leaking, blocked, no pressure) to share with the technician.

q: What tools should I have ready for a carpenter?
a: You don't need to provide tools. Our carpenters bring their own professional toolkits. Just ensure the work area is clear and accessible.

q: How does the electrician service work?
a: Book an electrician, describe the issue (wiring, fan, switchboard, etc.), and the technician will diagnose and fix the problem. All electrical work follows IS 732 safety standards.

q: Are the cleaning services eco-friendly?
a: Most of our cleaning professionals use standard commercial cleaning products. If you prefer eco-friendly products, please mention this in the booking description and they will try to accommodate.

q: What is the typical cost for painting a room?
a: Painting costs vary by room size and paint type. A 150 sq ft room typically costs ₹3,000–₹6,000 for two coats of standard emulsion paint, excluding material cost.

q: Can I book a technician for emergency repairs at night?
a: Currently, services are available from 6 AM to 10 PM. Emergency after-hours service is available only in select cities with a 30% surcharge.

q: How is ETA estimated?
a: ETA is calculated using the haversine formula to get precise GPS distance, then assuming 30 km/h average speed. Real traffic may affect actual arrival time.

q: What happens after the job is complete?
a: After the technician marks the job 'Completed', you'll receive a prompt to rate them (1–5 stars) and leave a review. This helps maintain quality on the platform.

q: Can I book multiple technicians at once?
a: Each booking is for one technician per service. If you need multiple services simultaneously, you can create separate bookings for each service type.

q: What is the refund policy?
a: If a job was not completed satisfactorily, contact support within 48 hours with photos. We'll assess the situation and may offer a partial or full refund or re-service.

q: What is masonry service?
a: Masonry services include brickwork, plastering, tile fixing, concrete repairs, and wall construction. Our masons handle both repair and small construction tasks.

q: How do I track my booking history?
a: Log in to your account and navigate to 'My Bookings'. You'll see all past and current bookings with their status, technician details, and cost summaries.

q: Is there a loyalty program?
a: We are developing a loyalty program that rewards frequent users with discounts and priority booking. Stay tuned for updates in the app.

q: How do I change my registered location?
a: Go to Profile settings and update your location. Alternatively, when booking, you can allow the app to use your current GPS location which overrides the registered address.

q: What is the minimum booking notice?
a: Bookings are instant — no minimum notice required. Our platform connects you to available technicians in real-time, so you can book and have someone on the way within minutes.

q: How does the AI booking assistant work?
a: Our AI assistant understands natural language. You can type 'my pipe is leaking' and it will classify your problem, find the best available plumber near you, and create the booking automatically.

q: What personal data do you collect?
a: We collect your name, email, and location for booking purposes. Payment is handled in cash directly with the technician. We never store credit card information.
